name: The Dark Country
author: Unknown — handwritten on paper, found under a streetlamp in the Circuit district
description:
This text was found folded beneath a streetlamp at the corner of Halsted and Division, written in black ink on paper torn from a notebook. The handwriting is steady. The paper was dry despite recent rain. No fingerprints. No DNA. The ink does not match any commercially available brand.

You are lost. Fear stopped haunting you miles back. Now it simply walks beside you, quiet, patient — a companion you never asked for and cannot leave behind.

The wilderness has no use for conscience. Everything here moves on instinct, all teeth and reflex and necessity. It acts. It either lives or it doesn't. There is a brutal honesty in that, if you're willing to look at it straight.

And yet here you are. The wildest, most uncharted territory you could find — and it was never the forest, was it? It was always this. The dark country behind your own eyes.
story_hooks: Identical copies of this text have been found under seven different streetlamps across three districts over the past year. Same handwriting. Same paper. Same ink. Always dry. Always found after rain.
